messages:
Ivy: Quick PSA: I'm doing a tiny wreath-making drop-off at my desk at 3pm. Bring any spare ribbon/ornaments if you want to contribute. No crafting skill required. :scissors:
Carlos: That sounds delightful. Bringing leftover ribbon from my unsuccessful bow era. :bow:
Nina: I'll bring some adhesive dots and glitter (contained in ziploc). Promise no glitter explosion. :sparkles:
Owen: Will there be hot cider? Because that will determine my attendance level. :apple:
Ivy: No official cider but I can bring a thermos. Kate-bot: Office snack budget update: small team events (under $25) approved when registered via the ops form. :money_with_wings:
Zoe: I'll swing by and bring mini pinecones I collected from the park. Cute and free. :pine_cone:
Carlos: Also, random poll: wreaths for office doors or for cubicles? React :one: door wreath, :two: desk wreaths, :three: both (small).
Nina: :three: both feels inclusive.
Owen: :one: for maximum hallway cheer.
Ivy: Poll leaning toward a mix. We'll make a handful of door-sized and a bunch of tiny desk rings.
Kate-bot: Reminder: Please avoid using real pine on office chairs due to allergies. :information_source:
Zoe: Tiny craft tip: use a hot glue gun on low setting and rest your wrists on a coaster. Learned that the painful way. :face_with_head_bandage:
Carlos: If anyone wants to make a name-tag ornament, I have a small stamp kit. Very low-effort personalization.
Ivy: Love that. Also shoutout to Nina for bringing glue dots last minute last week 00% saved decoration time. :clap:
Nina: Yay teamwork. Also I'll bring a 'glitter containment' shoebox for any rogue sparkles.
Owen: Cider status: bringing thermos + tiny paper cups. Non-alcoholic only. If people want mulled tea I can do that too.
Zoe: I'll tape a tiny sign at the building entrance that says "Wreath Sprint 3pm: drop by for a jingle"
Ivy: Plan: 3pm at my desk table, supplies provided, walk-ins welcome. If you're remote and want a kit, DM me and I can leave one at reception with your name.
Carlos: Can't wait. Also: friendly reminder to label anything you want back in the Lost & Found bin. We had two mystery wreaths last year.
Ivy: See you at 3. Bonus: small prize for the most creative tiny-wreath (sashimi-themed wreath is allowed but will be judged). :trophy:
